text:
elaine: Hey team — Acadia Health POC needs billing/org setup for trial. Requirements from AE:
- Hosted API keys for devs + option for Dedicated pool smoke test
- Spend cap: $1,000/week (enforced), project-level quotas for key rotation
- One-time free credits ask: $10,000 to cover pilot
- VPC option: evaluate gating later; needs approval if enabled
- Security questionnaire outstanding (data retention, KMS, logging)

marco: Quick q — expected steady-state QPS and model family? helps size Dedicated pool.

elaine: They expect bursts to ~120 req/s during sampling, avg ~12 req/s. Models: mix of 3B/20B open checkpoints; prefer quantized variants if we recommend Dedicated. They want ephemeral keys for engineers and an org billing project to separate usage.

nina: We can create a trial org + billing project. Two notes:
1) Spend caps are soft via quota today; SalesOps can set billing guardrails and alerts. For hard caps we need Finance to attach spend-shield policy.
2) Dedicated smoke requires reserved GPU quota; file a infra request with target window.

tom: I'll start the finance ticket. Need: customer legal name, billing contact, PO if applicable, and target start/end dates. Elaine — can you paste customer legal entity and contact?

elaine: Sent via DM: "Acadia Health Systems, tax ID XXXXXX" and billing contact + email. Start date next Monday for 4 weeks.

sai: Security checklist:
- Do they require data residency in EU/US? (they're US but need SOC2 clause)
- KMS/HSM required? If yes we must route to Private with KMS integration
- Logging/audit retention: default 90d, can extend but cost applies
Please attach completed security questionnaire answers.

provision-bot: Created ticket POC-475 in infra-provisioning. Status: awaiting finance approval and org id. ETA: 48h for org and hosted keys, 5-7 business days for Dedicated trial.

marco: Action items:
- elaine: confirm legal + billing PO (tom copied)
- tom: open finance ticket + enable spend-shield draft
- nina: reserve Dedicated pool tentative slot and estimate cost
- sai: review sec questionnaire answers and flag Private requirement
- me: prepare quickstart repo with ephemeral key instructions and sample config

elaine: thanks — I'll chase the PO and send the questionnaire answers today. ping me in thread with the finance ticket link.

provision-bot: POC-475 update: finance ticket FIN-223 created, assigned to @tom. Reminder: use `redwoodctl org create --name "Acadia-POC" --owner elaine --billing-project "Acadia-POC-billing"` once org id confirmed.

tom: FIN-223 created, requested PO and requested spend-shield options. I'll update here when approved.

nina: Reserving one node for smoke on 2026-04-01; cost estimate attached in FIN-223. If Dedicated approved we'll require customer approval for maintenance window.

elaine: great — leaving this open until FIN-223 is approved. :thumbsup:
